description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Assured is building a new generation of products for the insurance industry. As we take on more of the claims lifecycle, we’re helping people understand what happened, make complex decisions, and determine what should happen next.

We’re looking for a product design leader to shape our AI-powered Adjudication products across areas like Liability, Coverage, and Fraud. These products help answer some of the most important questions in a claim: who is responsible, what a policy covers, and what needs further investigation.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the Staff or Principal level, depending on experience and scope of impact. You’ll help set the design direction across our Adjudication products, partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and carry that direction through to the details of the experience.

You don’t need insurance experience. We’re looking for someone who enjoys learning complex domains, making sense of ambiguity, and turning complicated systems into thoughtful, understandable experiences.

🎯 What you’ll do

  • Set the design direction and lead execution across emerging Adjudication products, including Liability, Coverage, and Fraud.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science early to frame problems, explore opportunities, and shape product behavior.

  • Build a deep understanding of claims workflows, the people using our products, and the decisions they need to make.

  • Design how people understand evidence, evaluate AI recommendations, recognize missing information, and decide when to act or intervene.

  • Move from exploration and prototyping into detailed interaction and visual design, partnering with Engineering through implementation.

  • Work with designers across our agent, adjuster, and consumer experiences to make these capabilities feel cohesive wherever people encounter them.

  • Develop shared patterns for evidence, uncertainty, review, and escalation that can extend across products.

  • Work directly with customers and users to test ideas, learn from real use, and improve what we ship.

🧠 What we’re looking for

  • Experience setting design direction and leading substantial product design work in complex workflows, enterprise software, AI products, or decision-support tools.

  • Strong craft across interaction design, information architecture, and visual design, with a portfolio that shows how you make complex experiences clear and usable.

  • Systems thinking, connect individual interactions to broader workflows and patterns that scale.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering from early discovery through shipped experiences.

  • Thoughtful judgment about human–AI interaction, including when automation should act independently and how people evaluate outputs, correct mistakes, and maintain appropriate control.

  • The ability to create clarity, build alignment, and help other designers and partners move ambiguous work forward.

✨ You might be a great fit if...

You enjoy understanding how a system works as much as crafting how someone experiences it. You can get deep into a complicated problem, find a clear path through it, and stay involved until the details feel right.

You’re also comfortable working across product boundaries. A decision about liability might depend on information gathered from a claimant, work performed by an AI agent, and an adjuster’s review. You’re excited to connect those pieces and work with other designers to make the whole experience feel coherent.

Insurance experience is not required. Curiosity, strong product judgment, and the ability to make unfamiliar, complex problems understandable matter much more.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together
